# function: label

Pure equivalent of the null-context module. `context` is a parent (the `self` or `normalized_context` of an earlier call, or `null` for the module defaults) and `vars` holds this call's inputs (`name`, `attributes`, `tags`, ...). Returns an object with every module output.

## Example Usage

```terraform
locals {
  root  = provider::null-context::label(null, { namespace = "7pi", name = "a" })
  child = provider::null-context::label(local.root.self, { attributes = ["x"] })
}

output "child_id" {
  value = local.child.id # 7pi-a-x
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
label(context dynamic, vars dynamic) dynamic
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `context` (Dynamic, Nullable) Parent context or null.
1. `vars` (Dynamic, Nullable) Inputs of this call or null.
